execute.sql:
ALTER TABLE "public"."Agendamento"
              ADD CONSTRAINT "Agendamento_active_time_no_overlap"
              EXCLUDE USING gist (
                "massagistaId" WITH =,
                tstzrange("dataHora", "dataHoraFim", '[)') WITH &&
              )
              WHERE (
                "massagistaId" IS NOT NULL
                AND "dataHoraFim" IS NOT NULL
                AND "status" IN (
                  'PENDENTE',
                  'CONFIRMADO',
                  'REAGENDAMENTO_SOLICITADO',
                  'REAGENDADO'
                )
              )
